pairs.distinct_questions: Define specifies one bounded meaning-discovery outcome; Product Capability specifies the general form.
pairs.counterexample_to_collapse: Another Product Capability need not discover concept meaning; a CLI implementation is not either meaning.

pairs.distinct_questions: The former specifies an enabled outcome; the latter specifies an exact bundle produced or consumed.
pairs.counterexample_to_collapse: One capability can produce many pack revisions; one saved pack remains after its producing execution ends.

pairs.distinct_questions: A pack covers a required concept set and handling standing; a Definition assigns one scoped normative meaning.
pairs.counterexample_to_collapse: A pack with reuse and open outcomes creates no new Definition.

pairs.distinct_questions: The pack preserves semantic input; Review assesses exact subjects against questions and criteria.
pairs.counterexample_to_collapse: A pack can exist before any reviewer has assessed it.

pairs.distinct_questions: Concept handling state is distinct from exact governance requests and selected effects.
pairs.counterexample_to_collapse: A consumer may inspect a pack without any Decision request; one accepted member does not accept the rest.

pairs.distinct_questions: A resumable workflow record does not bind the complete Agent Session contract or constitute durable agent identity.
pairs.counterexample_to_collapse: A human can resume Define work after an earlier machine instance has terminated.

pairs.distinct_questions: Disposition answers how the concept is handled for one use; posture answers what authority an exact version has.
pairs.counterexample_to_collapse: Reuse can bind admitted meaning while propose carries candidate meaning; any transition remains an independent owner decision.

formal_obligations: DISP-01: a total single-valued disposition function over the declared finite concept set
REF-01: each selected reference has explicit resolved standing or a visible scoped gap
AUTH-01: pack validation does not entail semantic admission or execution permission
PART-01: admission of an exact selected output does not entail admission of other outputs
STATE-01: disposition, currentness, review-readiness and admission are not silently interchangeable
required_future_assurance: Bind exact clauses, signatures, assumptions and interpreted models before formal checks.
Review interpretation fidelity and expressibility; mark temporal/deontic/empirical obligations unsupported if the selected formal profile cannot express them.
Finite checking does not establish unrestricted consistency, exhaustive concept discovery or owner approval.
